summary: High-fidelity LeNet-5 replica: per-module specialist assets (SVG / Graphviz) imported into Draw.io; Draw.io only owns cross-module arrows and global labels.
module_count_rationale: 11 semantic modules: INPUT + four 3D stacks (C1/S2/C3/S4) + C5/F6/OUTPUT bands + four lower insets (5x5 conv, 2x2 sub, 3x3 conv, magenta C5 source) + FC network. Each contains a distinct visual unit; merging any neighboring pair would lose either a colored cross-anchor cell (red/green/blue/magenta) or an operation visualization.

components.name: INPUT 32x32
components.description: Gray 32x32 input plane with handwritten A and red source-pixel box.

components.name: C1: feature maps 6@28x28
components.description: Stack of 6 28x28 feature maps after a 5x5 convolution, with green selected and red output cells.

components.name: S2: f. maps 6@14x14
components.description: Stack of 6 14x14 maps after 2x2 subsampling, with green output cell and blue C3 receptive-field square.

components.name: C3: f. maps 16@10x10
components.description: Stack of 16 10x10 maps after 3x3 convolution, with a small blue target cell.

components.name: S4: f. maps 16@5x5
components.description: Stack of 16 5x5 maps after 2x2 subsampling, with green inner and magenta source-cell markers.

components.name: C5/F6/OUTPUT bands
components.description: Three slanted gray bands C5(120), F6(84), OUTPUT(10) with thin top connection line and red diagonal class digits 0..9.

components.name: 5x5 convolution inset
components.description: 7x7 input grid with overlapping blue/red 5x5 windows; dashed guides to a 3x3 output grid with red and blue output cells.

components.name: 2x2 subsampling inset
components.description: 3x3 input grid with green 2x2 window; dashed guides to a 3x3 output grid with a single green cell.

components.name: 3x3 convolution inset
components.description: 5x5 input grid with overlapping yellow/blue 3x3 windows; dashed guides to a 3x3 output grid with yellow and blue cells.

components.name: C5 source 5x5 grid
components.description: Magenta-bordered 5x5 cell grid representing the C5 source patch on S4. The 'Full connection' caption is on the Draw.io master, not inside this SVG.

components.name: FC 120 -> 84 -> 10
components.description: Dense three-rank fully connected node network laid out by Graphviz; the blue layer labels (120/84/10) and the red class digits 0..9 are added on the Draw.io master, not inside this Graphviz SVG.
